title: satureja parnassica subsp. athoa
intro: Satureja parnassica subsp. athoa, commonly known as Mountain savory, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, colds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain savory include its ability to relieve digestive issues, such as bloating and cramps, and its antimicrobial properties help to combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Mountain savory include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory actions.
